name: The EU AI Act in Practice
description: A practitioner's walk through the EU AI Act: who it reaches, which role you hold, what is prohibited, how to classify high-risk systems, and what providers, deployers and general-purpose AI model providers must actually do. Includes the timeline as amended by the Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744) and worked classification examples.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: The EU AI Act in Practice

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 21 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
